title: Near and Far: közel / messze with van

sections.content: közel ('near') and messze ('far') describe distance and are used together with van, since they describe where something is relative to the speaker -- the same van used for plain location.

items.spanish: A bank közel van. A posta is közel van.
items.english: The bank is near. The post office is near too.

sections.content: közel and messze always need van beside them -- they describe a location relationship, not an identity, so this is not the zero-copula case. Compare 'A bank közel van' with 'A bank nagy' (no van, because nagy is just describing what the bank is like).
